newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta,Manitoba Pools up United Grain stake.
newsitem.headline: Alberta,Manitoba Pools up United Grain stake.

text.p: Alberta Wheat Pool and Manitoba Pool Elevators raised their stake in United Grain Growers Ltd common shares to 14.98 percent this week, an AWP and MPE joint press release said.
The privately held cooperatives on Wednesday and Thursday purchased 255,500 limited voting common shares at an average price of C$12.65 a share, AWP spokesman Dale Riddell said.
UGG's board of directors on Friday announced they adopted a poison pill provision to stall any firm or group of firms from acquiring more than 15 percent of outstanding shares.

Whether the cooperatives can each purchase an additional 15 percent outside the numbered company in addition to their current holdings without triggering the poison pill was cause for disagreement among Winnipeg grain analysts and lawyers.
MPE officials declined comment while AWP spokesman Riddell said disclosure of his firm's strategy would have to wait until after a delegate meeting later this month.
UGG chief executive Brian Hayward declined comment.
